crescent_fan.text: That's the Crescent. Georgian, grand and very cold.
They built it to rival Bath. Bath hasn't noticed yet.

well_filler.text: St Ann's Well. Twenty-eight degrees, all year round.
I've filled forty bottles. I'm not thirsty. I just can't stop.

opera_fan.text: The Opera House has the best acoustics in the Peaks.
I once sang the whole of Carmen. The pigeons applauded. Politely.

duck_fan.text: Pavilion Gardens. Ducks have right of way. It's on the sign.
I've tried arguing. The ducks don't read.

goyt_guide.text: That gap leads up into the Goyt Valley. It's the old packhorse road to Manchester.
Salt and silk went one way, cotton the other. Nowadays it's mostly walkers and the odd lost sat-nav.
Wrap up. Manchester is thirty miles north and, I'm told, wetter.
